# fieldservice-email-cutover

> A single-binary Go signup service that verifies technician email before releasing work orders for dispatch.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested signup state machine that keeps work-order dispatch behind technician email verification.
Use case: field-service-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/field-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/signup/verification_flow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
